newsitem.title: USA: Poland sells $400 mln in two-part Yankee debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells $400 mln in two-part Yankee debt deal.

text.p: The following two-tranche Yankee debt deal from Poland was priced on Thursday, according to lead manager JP Morgan Securities Inc.
TYPE NOTES ISS PRICE 99.491 FIRST PAY DATE 1/1/1998
LAST MOODY'S BAA3 YIELD 7.219 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P BBB-MINUS SPREAD 75 BPS CALLABLE NO
TYPE NOTES ISS PRICE 99.299 FIRST PAY DATE 1/1/1998
LAST MOODY'S BAA3 YIELD 7.820 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P BBB-MINUS SPREAD 100 BPS CALLABLE NO
NOTE: The $300 million notes were priced at a spread of 75 basis points over the blend of the U.S. Treasury notes due May 2004 and August 2007.
The $100 million notes were priced at a spread of 100 basis points over 6 1/2 percent U.S. Treasury bond due November 2026.
